A1.justification: Both PDFs describe InverFill and contain readable main text, equations, all nine tables, fourteen figures, and supplementary material. Content can be reliably matched despite repagination and section moves.

before.justification: v1 reports original inpainting evaluations, runtime measurements, ablations, and qualitative analyses on BrushBench, MagicBrush, FFHQ, and DIV2K.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and analyses, with revised numerical results in several main-text and supplementary tables.

M1.justification: The inversion architecture, synthetic training procedure, reconstruction objectives, Re-Blending, Gaussian regularization, adversarial loss, and inference pipeline remain unchanged in Sections 3–4.

E1.justification: Both versions retain BrushData/MSCOCO training prompts and BrushBench, MagicBrush, FFHQ, and DIV2K evaluations, including enhanced captions and varied masks. Removing the Additional Experiments heading does not remove its datasets or results.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same SANA, SDXL, BrushNet, HD-Painter, and SDXL-Inpainting methods. The SDS regularization comparator and DDIM inversion variants also remain in Tables 5–6.

E3.justification: Tables 1, 2, and 4–6 now specify HPSv2.1 instead of HPS, described as HPS v2 in v1 Section 5.2. This is a limited reported metric-version revision, although v2 Section 5.2 retains the old description and does not establish whether rescoring occurred. Splits, resolution, NFEs, and training budgets otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 2 and 4–8 revise quantitative evidence for existing loss-weight, regularization, component, and DDIM analyses. The questions and component configurations remain unchanged, as do the LPIPS/JSD analysis and failure examples; no new ablation or robustness scenario is introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, evaluation seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Revised point estimates do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical results are extensively revised in Tables 1, 2, and 4–8. For example, Table 1's BrushBench IR scores for SANA-Sprint plus InverFill at 2/4 NFEs change from 11.65/11.76 to 11.76/11.58, reversing their ranking. Tables 3 and 9 and the qualitative examples remain unchanged. These are revised reported results, not demonstrated same-protocol performance gains.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–13, including the moment-matching regularizer and training objectives, are unchanged. Neither version adds proofs or formal theoretical results.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims: one-step inversion improves few-step inpainting through semantically informed initialization, without real-image supervision and with minimal overhead.

C2.justification: The explanations involving information leakage, Gaussian alignment, and background preservation remain unchanged, as does the color-inconsistency limitation. The societal-impacts discussion is relocated rather than substantively revised.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link but removes the appendix statement that FFHQ/DIV2K evaluations reuse Section 5 checkpoints without modification or fine-tuning. Hardware, training duration, learning rates, batch size, and selected loss weights remain documented as before.

R1.justification: v2 adds Anti-i2v to the societal-impacts citations and removes the NTIRE 2017 dataset reference associated with DIV2K. The remaining references largely undergo renumbering; the main related-work discussion and novelty positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: Societal Impacts moves from supplementary Section 14 to main Section 6, with corresponding renumbering. The Additional Experiments heading and introductory paragraph disappear while its dataset details and results remain. Most prose is otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Several tables change metric headings, scaling-label placement, and emphasis. Appendix Figures 11–12 shift position, and the project link and relocated text alter page flow. All figures and tables are retained without substantive graphical redesign.

improvement.justification: The project-page link and more specific metric labels offer limited documentation benefits, but v2 removes checkpoint-reuse information. Extensive score revisions are unexplained, and HPSv2.1 table labels coexist with HPS v2 in Section 5.2. The PDFs do not establish whether the revised empirical evidence is more accurate, leaving the net effect on paper quality uncertain.
